profile.legalName: California Department of Food and Agriculture
profile.summary: A California state agency that oversees animal health and food safety, plant health and pest prevention, measurement standards, inspection services and agricultural marketing. It supports farmers through grant programs and keeps agricultural statistics. It also runs the Farm to School Incubator Grant Program, which funds school food and garden projects.
